previous_statement: Assuming the compatibility obligation in node 1.3, let M be any compact C^1 manifold and choose the class-one allowable atlas supplied there. Node 1.1 then gives a finite cover of M by domains of allowable coordinate systems; node 1.2, using GT-cairns-1935-theorem-p549, gives that M is homeomorphic to a finite simplicial complex. Since M was arbitrary, this is the root conclusion.
new_statement: Dependency audit: nodes 1.1 and 1.2 prove only the conditional implication that a compact modern C^1 manifold which is also a Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead class-one manifold and has an allowable atlas is homeomorphic to a finite simplicial complex. Node 1.3 states that the allowed inputs do not establish that every compact modern C^1 manifold satisfies those historical hypotheses. Hence these dependencies do not prove the unconditional root conclusion; the historical-to-modern compatibility bridge must be supplied as an additional allowed input before the root can be derived.
